_comment: Optional config. Delete this file and the scanner still works with safe defaults. All keys are optional.
_base_ref: Git ref to diff against for scoped scans. null = auto-detect (origin/HEAD, origin/main, origin/master, main, master).
_disabled_checks: List any check ids you never want to run, e.g. ["gitleaks", "npm-audit"]. Valid ids: ruff, ruff-format, mypy, bandit, pip-audit, eslint, prettier, tsc, npm-audit, gitleaks, supabase.
_node_max_old_space_mb: Heap limit (MB) given to eslint/prettier/tsc via NODE_OPTIONS. Large TS projects run out of memory at Node's ~2 GB default. Ignored if NODE_OPTIONS already sets --max-old-space-size.
_format_checks: prettier / ruff-format: "auto" = findings only if a hook, CI step or lint-staged entry enforces the formatter, otherwise advisory INFO; "enforce" = always findings; "advisory" = always INFO.
_ai_max_chunks: Large diffs are split per file into parts for the AI review. Max parts per reviewer (each part is one claude call). --ai-max-chunks overrides.
_ai_chunk_chars: Max characters of diff per AI part.
_ai_exclude: Globs the AI never reads (deterministic checks still scan them). gitignore-style: "docs/**", "**/__snapshots__/**", "*.md", "public/**". Lockfiles, minified, maps and binaries are always left out.
_ai_context_lines: Unchanged lines shown around each change in the AI diff. 1-2 saves tokens on big branches; 3 is git's default.
_ai_ignore_whitespace: true = drop whitespace-only changes from the AI diff (big savings after a reformat). Keep false for Python/YAML, where indentation matters.
_ai_commit_context: Send the reviewed commits' subject lines (max 40) with the diff so the reviewer knows the intent.
_group_trailer: Commit trailer that names a commit's feature group (--plan-groups / --group). Comma-separate values to put a commit in several groups.
_group_message_chars: Max characters of full commit messages sent with each group's review. Beyond it, later commits keep only their subject line.
_group_hub_files: Globs that never link unlabelled commits into one group (package.json, lockfiles and files touched by >30% of commits are always hubs).
